status: Game values for simcore/voice_comms.hpp and simcore/radio_nets.hpp (docs/crew/12_COMMUNICATIONS.md): how long hands take on a box and a headset, what weak jamming costs, when the enemy is taken to have fixed a net. Not system data: where a value has a source it says so, the rest are SAM3D's.
notes: Strong jamming loses every message at a receiver it reaches; weak jamming loses each with `weak_jam_loss` and the speaker says a command twice (rrs_1986: under strong interference commands may be repeated twice), so the chance that both are lost is its square. A spot jammer finds a net's new frequency after its own `follow_s` (the scenario's). Direction finding: palii_1989 credits the US with 6-12 VHF bearings a minute; one tier-4 lesson says 30 s on air is enough. SAM3D counts each net's time on air in a sliding window; past `df_fix_s` in `df_window_s` the net is fixed and, after `df_reaction_s`, a spot jammer comes on it (when the scenario allows it: `jamming_follows_df`).

headset_s.source: sam3d estimate (the helmet on, the cord plugged in)

box_select_s.source: sam3d estimate (one turn of a box's selector)

answer_line_s.source: sam3d estimate (the lever up, or the handset taken)

recognise_jamming_s.source: sam3d estimate (a trained listener; the skill tier scales it)

order_spare_s.source: sam3d estimate (the main station's commander decides to leave a jammed frequency)

weak_jam_loss.source: sam3d (palii_1989: an operator stops understanding at about 50 % loss of information; weak jamming taken below that)

call_wait_s.source: rrs_1986 (after a change, no call from the main station in 1-2 min: call it)

both_frequencies_s.source: rrs_1986 (no contact in 5 min: work the old and the new frequency)

loss_report_s.source: rrs_1986 (no contact in 10 min: report the loss of communication)

df_fix_s.source: sam3d (a tier-4 lesson: 30 s on air is detected; palii_1989: 6-12 bearings a minute)

df_reaction_s.source: sam3d estimate (the jammer is tasked and tuned)

warn_covered_m.source: sam3d (pvo_bu_x_1984: the air-defence units warn the covered troops of the air enemy; how far out is the battery commander's call)
